Detailed specifications provided for the pressure regulator.
The document describes pressure regulators for Amime Feed to Chemical Quilt service.
Tags include PCV 1-367B and PCV 2-367B.
Max flow is 7.6 GPM at 1 psi, with operating temperatures up to 150 Deg. F.
Body materials are SS-316 for the body, spring, and case.
Packing material is 416 SST, and diaphragm material is 302 SST.
Spring range is 50-250 psig with a setting of 10 psig.
Manufacturer is ABENGOA SOLAR and ABENER TEYMA SOLANA AG ENGINEERING.
